assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: production app logo icon for Driftwatch, a professional website-change monitoring app. Create ONE genuinely exceptional compact brand emblem on a truly transparent background, no lettering, no presentation board. Subject: an ownable sculptural folded-loop D / observation portal, two precisely interlocking smooth ribbons with a single offset that suggests detection of a change. Elegant broad silhouette, premium industrial design, striking clear identity at 24 pixels. Materials: luminous deep emerald glass face and satin pale champagne-metal inner edge, restrained lime refraction, physically plausible polished edges and subtle dimensional depth. More sophisticated than a flat stock monogram, but no intricate filigree or clutter. Front-facing centered nearly square emblem occupying 82% of a square canvas, slightly dimensional rather than extreme perspective. Thin graceful highlight, dark emerald structural edge so it reads on both white and charcoal. Transparent empty space outside and inside the aperture, no rectangular tile background, no cast floor shadow. Avoid: ECG zigzags, checkmarks, eyes, random orbit rings, letters in text, mockups, watermark, generic AI starburst. Deliver a beautiful finished standalone logo raster asset with preserved alpha.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished panoramic photographic-quality premium website background for Driftwatch, not a UI screenshot. A striking sculptural emerald optical ribbon / folded observation portal on the RIGHT half of a very wide cinematic composition, two sweeping glossy jade-glass and champagne-metal ribbons interacting with precise moving light, evoking a change propagating through layered observations. Deep forest-black studio atmosphere, translucent emerald gradients, fine glass caustics and warm ivory specular accents, luxurious refined industrial sculpture with tactile dimensional detail. Left 45% stays dark, quiet and low-detail for white interface headlines; sculpture and luminous refracted waves gather right of center and flow past right and lower edges. Very wide 16:9 panoramic composition suitable for a full-bleed landing hero and login backdrop. Beautiful enough to be the central visual identity, visible at normal viewing size; no excessive haze, no indistinct generic blobs. Colors forest #111a17, emerald #2f805e, subtle lime #c1e88b and champagne #e7d8b6. The picture must be pure artwork without ANY text, UI cards, charts, plots, graphs, grids, logos or watermarks. Avoid purple cyberpunk, stock space stars, excessive rings, clutter, cliché circuit boards. Create the actual finished background artwork.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: sophisticated full-canvas BACKGROUND ART for a real monitoring application dashboard, not a rendered UI. Panoramic airy warm ivory and mist-jade environment with elegant sculptural translucent emerald-glass ribbons and satin champagne-metal folds drifting around the TOP RIGHT and LOWER LEFT edges. An optical wave moving through precise layers, derived from premium physical material rather than generic CSS gradients. Broad identifiable flowing forms, subtle fine micro-texture in the glass, beautiful light and dimensional caustics, tasteful architectural studio lighting. Calm nearly empty warm ivory center suitable for dark dashboard labels, while the corners and top band contain substantial visually impressive sculptural imagery that remains clearly visible behind translucent cards. Bright polished editorial design, coherent forest/emerald/lime/champagne brand palette; no washed-out barely perceptible shapes. Wide 16:9 composition, use the full canvas with flowing forms that crop attractively on mobile. Pure raster background artwork, no words, icons, UI, charts, tables, fake screenshots, watermarks, borders, grids, unrelated objects or space imagery. Deliver a beautifully finished background that can cover an entire app workspace with high legibility.
